messages:
sam_sales: VertexBank POC asking for SOC2 Type II PDF, ISO excerpt, pen-test attestation, and a clear delta on hosted vs dedicated (latency + cost). Need by tomorrow morning. Any blockers?
ria_se: We can bundle SOC2.pdf + control_mapping.csv + iso_scope.pdf. Pen-test: attestation letter available; full report needs NDA + vendor approval. @noah_security can confirm timelines.
noah_security: Attestation ready same day. Full pentest requires NDA + redaction and add ~48h. Also: we'll provide a vulnerability snapshot, but no customer-specific findings. Note: do NOT upload PII or private keys.
lucy_legal: NDA template ready; if they sign our mutual NDA we can proceed with redacted report. Otherwise send attestation only. NDA turnaround ~24h if counter-signed promptly.
mike_fin: Quick pricing summary: hosted unit cost lower; dedicated reserved pool ~28% higher committed monthly cost for same sustained throughput. For POC we can offer 14-day reserved trial with 500k token cap and staging IPs. I'll add numbers to a one-pager.
sam_sales: They want to upload a 1GB trace to reproduce an edge case. Preferred: presigned S3 (7d). Include redaction checklist.
ria_se: I'll generate presigned link + example upload command. Redaction checklist: remove PII, mask PHI, strip API keys and session tokens, remove KMS plaintext.
noah_security: If they insist on sending sensitive material, we need isolated SFTP and signed DSA. Also we'll only accept sanitized logs.
transfer-bot: Evidence ticket created: EVID-9900 (VertexBank POC). Owner: ria_se.
sam_sales: Please bundle SOC2.pdf, control_mapping.csv, iso_scope.pdf, pentest_attestation.pdf, poc_pricing_onepager.pdf, and key_docs_readme.txt into a single zip for delivery. I'll email their CISO.
mike_fin: One-pager draft will include: Hosted (on-demand) - per-token + per-rps; Dedicated (reserved) - monthly reserve + burst; trial: 14 days, 500k tokens cap, expected p95 latency hosted ~110-140ms vs dedicated ~40-65ms at their target load. ETA: 6pm PT.
ria_se: Presigned link posted privately and redaction guide attached.
noah_security: Attestation signed by security lead ready. If legal requests redlines, ping @lucy_legal.
sam_sales: Thanks all — will send bundle once Mike and Ria confirm final docs. :thumbsup:
